errors.quote: where $W$ counts wires and $m$ is the label dimension
errors.problem: $m=h^3$ is the dimension of the ambient label space $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$. Individual labels have dimensions from $0$ to $m$.

errors.quote: Since $t_S,t_T$ have three ones, $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$ and $\langle t_T,t_T\rangle=2,$ so each triple line is nondegenerate.
errors.problem: This sentence follows the definitions of both networks, but these values hold only for the rational form. Over $\mathbb F_2$ with the dot product, $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod2$ and $t_T\cdot t_T=1$; a norm of $2$ would be $0$ there and make the line isotropic. The paper states $t_T\cdot t_T=1$ separately for the complex network.

errors.quote: Gate labels at times $0$ to $7$ are $B\otimes\langle t_T\rangle,$ $B\otimes F,$ $(B\otimes F)\oplus(R\otimes\langle t_T\rangle),$ $A\otimes F,$ $B\otimes F,$ $(B\otimes F)\oplus(R\otimes\langle t_T\rangle^\perp),$ $A\otimes F,$ $A\otimes F,$
errors.problem: The same $t_T$ is used at every time. In the paper $t$ is the indicator of the physical triple that indexes each gate: the $Y$ triple at times 0 and 5, the $X$ triple at time 2. Read literally, the time-2 and time-5 labels on a side wire would not be nested, since $t_T\notin t_T^\perp$. The labels also drop the factor $Q$ (paper: 'All labels are tensored by $Q$') without saying so.

errors.quote: The side edge has residual $R\otimes\langle t_S,t_T\rangle^\perp$ of dimension $h-2,$
errors.problem: A side wire has several edges (source$\to0$, $0\to2$, $2\to5$, $5\to7$, last$\to$sink) with different residuals. This residual, tensored by $Q$, belongs to the edge $2\to5$ only.

errors.quote: The pair $X_a\to Y_a$ has inverse kernels, which $C=iZC^{-1}Z$ with $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$ turns into $C,$ so every role carries $C^{\otimes m}.$
errors.problem: Only the 27 coordinates of $\operatorname{supp}(u_a)$ carry $C^{-1}$; the rest carry $C$. Turning them into $C$ needs the diagonal corrections $Z_{a,k}$ before $X_a$ and $i^{27k}Z_{a,k}$ after $Y_a$. The physical $X$ outputs must also be negated to undo the sign of the scalar exchange $(X,Y)\mapsto(-Y,X)$. The paper's claim holds only 'after source and sink diagonal corrections, and undoing the signed bank exchange'.
